These are in various stages of evaluation/development. Load projections for the DP’s currently indicate over 4900 MW of new load by year 2029, growing to over 6,800 MW by year 2032. There is currently only one 230kV transmission source in the corridor from Elmont to Fredericksburg, along with one 115kV source that was recently rebuilt. Without diverse transmission sources to serve the new substations, it is anticipated that initial facility interconnections with the one 230kV transmission line will have to be reworked as additional transmission lines are required in the corridor to address new reliability violations | 1 - Previously presented Do No Harm supplemental project DOM-2023-0016, 0053, 0055, 2024-0012 will wreck and rebuild 230kV line 256/2032 (Kraken-Elmont) with double circuit structures and 115kV line #47 (Fredericksburg-Four Rivers) and line #73 (Four Rivers-Elmont) with double circuit structures (from Kraken to Allman/Fburg). 2025 Open Window awarded a 5/2 circuit from Kraken to Elmont. 2 - Install second 230kV conductor on both the double circuit structures from Kraken to Elmont. One line will terminate at Elmont and the other will bypass Elmont and terminate at Chickahominy. This conductor will continue on Line 557 5/2 structures. 3 - Install 230kV conductor on open arms of existing 230kV Line #2075 from Elmont to Chickahominy and terminate at Elmont and Chickahominy. 4 - 2025 Open Window Project b3692 will rebuild 500kV Line #557 as 5/2 structures, and the 230kV conductor is being strung but not terminated in that baseline project.
